findings.scenario: S26 (extraction scope) — the Phase-2 EXTRACT-CLEAN discipline vs the Phase-0 pin
findings.observed: the Phase-0 extraction pin said 'the ~10 tools' pure logic -> src/contract/analysis'; the disciplined extraction ports only the SIX tools whose facts are the pinned sub-axis categories (auth-surface · call-graph · upgrade-check · storage-layout · value-flow · state-flow) into src/contract/facts.ts, and consciously skips four (contract-info · inheritance-resolver · dimensional-analysis · mutation-map)
findings.rootCause: porting all ten tools' logic would add ~800 LOC with NO current caller (their outputs aren't in the sub-axis fact list) — the speculative 'while we're here' surface PART CLEAN + THE FIREWALL forbid
findings.fix: the extraction pin was TIGHTENED to state the actual scope (toolsPorted [6] + toolsNotPorted [4] + rationale) — a conscious re-pin cf620520... -> 4275f739..., surfaced in the Phase-2 marker (E.3 / P2). The four remain in the Sentinel source, extractable later if a real caller emerges.
findings.retest: honesty_pins asserts the 6/4 scope + the re-pinned golden; contract_extract asserts zero model/sibling import in src/contract/*; two consecutive clean runs identical

findings.scenario: S25 (the scorecard-via-Ask invariant) — appending the contract grounding rows
findings.observed: ask_tools asserted scorecardFor(...).facts is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the screen's factRows; appending the contract-screen grounding rows (so the Ask can phrase the contract facts) broke the strict equality
findings.rootCause: the invariant predated the deep counterparty axis; the Ask legitimately surfaces MORE than the bare seven axis rows (as stampFor already does with its depth rows)
findings.fix: the invariant was refined, not weakened: the scorecard-AXIS fact rows stay byte-identical as a PREFIX of the Ask facts; the contract detail is APPENDED (and asserted — id 'contract-screen', value = the engine's own tier). The engine is still the single source.
findings.retest: ask_tools: the prefix is byte-identical + the appended rows are the contract facts; two consecutive clean runs identical

findings.scenario: S25 (the Ask verdict guard) — the contract tier word colliding with a scorecard verdict
findings.observed: the contract tier UNVERIFIED is ALSO a scorecard verdict word; a SOLID pool with an UNVERIFIED contract screen would false-trip the verdict guard when the AI honestly said 'the contract screen is UNVERIFIED' (UNVERIFIED not in the allowed set {SOLID})
findings.rootCause: the verdict guard grounded only the scorecard/stamp verdicts; the contract tier is a distinct engine fact that shares the UNVERIFIED word
findings.fix: meta.contractTier is set in scorecardFor and added to the verdict guard's allowed keys — the engine's OWN contract tier is grounded, so an honest 'the contract screen is UNVERIFIED' passes while a gap-filled scorecard 'UNVERIFIED' on a SOLID pool would still be caught by the deterministic summary leading with the real verdict
findings.retest: ask_grounded + honesty_counterparty_contract green; the safety guard still rejects a fabricated 'safe'; two consecutive clean runs identical
